skills.name: London Rain
skills.description: Drops knives onto enemies' heads. Bad effects on enemies.  *Continuously cancels enemy invincibility (5 sec) *ATK x 2800% Area Damage  *ATK per sec x 500% Area Damage (5 sec) *Negates enemies' regen (5 sec)

skills.name: One and Only Gift
skills.description: Protects from malice downpours. Good effects to allies.  *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec) *Skill Resistance +60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Record of Ragnarok Ⅱ
abilities.description: Record of Ragnarok Ⅱ Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Deploy: Assassination
abilities.description: Has a set chance of making a Reaper appear, killing 1 enemy Ranger instantly when Rangers deploy.　  - Activates only in PVP and Guild Battles. - Activates 5 seconds after battles start. - Abilities with the same effect will not activate again for 3 seconds. - Bosses, Guardians, and special type enemies are not affected by this Ability.
